children: Meta Platforms (META, Financials) is broadening access to its AI-powered smart glasses as SoftBank is set to roll out the new Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 in Japan on September 25.
The introduction comes as the glasses are being rolled out more widely throughout the world and gives Meta another distribution channel in a key consumer technology industry.

SoftBank has been slowly expanding its smart-glasses business in Japan. In June it became the country's first mobile network operator to sell Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 glasses and in August it once again enlarged its Meta glasses assortment.
Alongside the Gen 3 launch, the business will also add Meta Glasses by LISA to its lineup.

The expansion important to Meta because smart glasses are a more obvious piece of its push to extend artificial intelligence beyond smartphones and PCs. Wider retail and carrier availability could help Meta gage if AI-powered wearables could evolve into a substantial consumer hardware category.
Meta shares closed up 4.5% at $777.59 on Thursday. SoftBank Group's U.S.-listed shares slumped 7.6%.
The next catalyst will be consumer demand for Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 after its global introduction and if Meta can continue to grow distribution into more markets.

title: Meta Just Got a Big New Partner for Its AI Glasses Push
